description: This file defines Swagger API documentation models for Self Beneficiaries Transfer Parameters and Responses in the Fineract project. It specifies data transfer objects (DTOs) for requests, responses, and template data related to self-beneficiary transfer in the portfolio self-account API.

classes.name: SelfBeneficiariesTPTApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Container for all Swagger schema definitions related to Self Beneficiaries Transfer API.

classes.name: GetSelfBeneficiariesTPTTemplateResponse
classes.description: Response schema for the template data of self-beneficiaries transfer, includes account options.

classes.name: GetSelfBeneficiariesAccountOptions
classes.description: Represents options for account types available for self-beneficiary transfers.

classes.name: PostSelfBeneficiariesTPTRequest
classes.description: Request schema for creating a new self-beneficiary transfer record.

classes.name: PostSelfBeneficiariesTPTResponse
classes.description: Response schema after creating a self-beneficiary transfer record, includes resource ID.

classes.name: PutSelfBeneficiariesTPTBeneficiaryIdRequest
classes.description: Request schema for updating a self-beneficiary transfer record by ID.

classes.name: PutSelfBeneficiariesTPTBeneficiaryIdResponse
classes.description: Response schema after updating a self-beneficiary transfer record, includes resource ID and changes.

classes.name: PutSelfBeneficiariesChanges
classes.description: Encapsulates changes made during an update operation.

classes.name: DeleteSelfBeneficiariesTPTBeneficiaryIdResponse
classes.description: Response schema after deleting a self-beneficiary transfer record, includes resource ID.

classes.name: GetSelfBeneficiariesTPTResponse
classes.description: Schema for retrieving details of a self-beneficiary transfer record.
